title: flowintel contains an authorization bypass in its task completion workflow for privileged cases. (CVE-2026-133837)
description: flowintel prior to version 4.1.0 contains an authorization bypass vulnerability in its task completion workflow for privileged cases. Users with lower-privilege roles such as editor or queuer could mark tasks as completed without the required approver review from Admin, Case Admin, or Queue Admin roles. This bypass undermines the mandatory approval workflow and allows unauthorized modification of task completion status. The vulnerability can be exploited through multiple methods including the browser UI, REST API, changing task status to "Finished", creating tasks with the completed flag set, and using UUID aliases or Matrix delegation.
